title: LernLab card (.lernpack format version 1)
description: One card: one line of cards.jsonl, or one element of the cards.json array. See docs/FORMAT.md. Readers must ignore keys they do not know, so this schema allows additional properties. Text fields may use the safe HTML list in docs/FORMAT.md; everything else is removed on import.

id.description: Stable id chosen by the writer, so a re-import updates the card and keeps progress. Write a string; readers also accept a number. Without an id, cards are matched by deck name plus front and back.

type.description: Card type. Without it the reader picks one from the content (a {{c1::...}} front is a cloze, choices make an mcq, steps make an order card). numeric: the back is a number with an optional unit; code: a code snippet in `code` (both added after v1 was published). Readers treat an unknown type as if it were missing.

front.description: Term, question or prompt. Cloze: text with {{c1::answer}} or {{c1::answer::hint}} (Anki syntax). A card with an empty front is skipped.

altAnswers.description: Other accepted answers, separated by |, e.g. "colour|color".

example.description: Example sentence. Mark the studied word with ... to get fill-the-gap rounds.

explanation.description: Shown after answering: a rule or rationale.

category.description: Group for sorting rounds, e.g. der/die/das or Storage/Compute.

choices.description: Multiple choice: the choices, separated by |.

correct.description: Multiple choice: the correct choices as 1-based numbers or as texts, separated by |.

steps.description: Ordering card: the steps in the correct order, separated by |.

tolerance.description: Numeric card: how far a typed number may be off and still count, as a number in the card's unit ("0.05") or a percentage ("1%"). Added after v1 was published; older readers ignore it.

code.description: Code card: the code snippet as plain text (never HTML), with its line breaks and indentation. A {{c1::token}} gap makes a fill-the-token card; a back makes predict-the-output; otherwise the lines are put in order. Added after v1 was published; older readers ignore it.

codeLang.description: Code card: the snippet's programming language, e.g. python, javascript, sql (optional; used for highlighting and read out to screen readers).

image.description: Image file name inside media/ (any subfolder; matched by file name), or an https:// URL. GIFs are images.

imageAlt.description: Optional, added after v1 was published; older readers ignore it. A short plain-text description of the image, read out by screen readers (its alt text), so picture questions can be answered without seeing them. Leave it out for a decorative image.

audio.description: Audio file name inside media/, or an https:// URL.

video.description: Video file name inside media/ (mp4 or webm), or an https:// URL.

subdeck.description: Sub-deck path, with :: between levels, e.g. "Medicine::Cardio".

group.description: Lesson group: cards with the same group are taught together in a mini-lesson.

rank.description: Introduction order, e.g. word frequency rank. Lower comes first.

extra.description: Any other fields, as an object of strings, e.g. {"reading": "..."}.
